Mira K: Heads-up — I tried merging Tidepool's LoRA into base-v2 and ran a quick smoke evalpack. Seeing a weird token-shift on numeric fields after quantizing to 4-bit. Anyone else catch this?
Chen Li: hmm, can you paste the smoke command you ran?
Mira K: ran: `./scripts/run_smoke.sh --model rwd/base-v2 --adapter tidepool-lora.safetensors --quant q4_0 --batch 16 --seed 42`
Chen Li: thanks. results? metrics?
Mira K: shortlog: `EM: 0.78 -> 0.62`, `F1: 0.81 -> 0.66`, token-level diff: `avg_shift=0.03`, and tokenizer unknowns spiked on invoice amounts. sample: "Invoice 245 -> Invoice 24 5" (split inserted).
Alex S: that sounds like tokenizer boundary changes after merge+quant. Did you run tokenizer sanity (vocab/hash) vs base?
Mira K: yes — tokenizer hashes match, vocab size identical. But when running merged model locally the tokenization step for digits emits an extra separator token in ~1.8% of cases.
Chen Li: could be adapter scaling/alpha. Try merge with alpha=0.5 or re-scaling adapter weights before quant. Also try `--merge-order=postnorm` vs default.
Mira K: good call — re-ran merge with `alpha=0.5` and `--merge-order=postnorm` then quantized; EM recovered to 0.73 and unk spikes dropped to 0.4%. Not perfect but much better.
Alex S: nice. Also try doing quantization after merge vs quantizing adapter separately then merging — ordering matters with int4 kernels.
Chen Li: infra-bot: can you spin a quick dedicated micro-run (2 x A10) for a ~2k sample smokepack for Tidepool so we can validate across longer tails?
infra-bot: Scheduled run 7865432122 on dedicated-qa-a10-2 (ETA ~6m). Logs will appear in /runs/7865432122/ and notify here when done. :gear:
Mira K: thanks infra-bot. If the dedicated run still shows tail cases, plan B: run a targeted token-remap on digit tokens from Tidepool's promptset and add a small adapter patch.
Alex S: agree. Also capture a few failing examples and add to the eval set for regression alerts.
Mira K: will do — saving failing examples to `s3://redwood-smoke/tidepool/fails/7865432122.jsonl`. Will update thread when infra run completes. :thumbsup:
